restrictions: This entry uses the exact two-round BLAKE3 55/63-byte non-root last-chunk half-collision construction from proof.md. The type-conditioned test-(2) DFA enforces f9 xor f10 = 1 and f24 xor f25 = 1 xor t, t = (Y4 bit4 xor Y4 bit5), with the two exact lists selected from the member type. Each list word is first tested by an exact packed Y9 prefilter (Lemma PF, U_PF = 8 units, its six constants in registers): exhaustive enumeration of the bit-serial decision of condition (1) over all 1024 low-ten-bit prefixes leaves 14, all with Y9 bits {0,1,2,6,7,8,9} equal to 0x004 or 0x3c4, so a word with no such lane holds no lane passing test (1) and is skipped losslessly; E work is charged only for the lanes of kept words. With straight-line immediate-displacement word loads, U_WORD = 45 (without the -1, which a skipped word does not execute; a kept word spends it on its W add), U_PARTIAL = 2, and WORDS_BUDGET = ceil(E_B/7) + 28 LIVE_B. No H_HIT premise is used; H_PF bounds kept words and is protected by the W <= WB halt.

The member class has 262144 members of each type. Exact E-word counts are 23820160 and 34028800 and each type has 4160 live low-half states; the online source builds both tables and checks these identities. Messages are distinct and the four fixed digest words are checked by the inherited construction.

The exact integer ledger, all budgets, power certificate, memory and inherited success premises are in the first section of proof.md. N=84377580337144965278 and log2(N/430)=57.44530066981970, rounded up to 57.4454 (base entries b026078f: 57.4702, 9472755a: 57.5916). With WORDS_BUDGET = 1090817248070415855, the kept-word budget PF_BUDGET = ceil(WORDS_BUDGET/8) + s = 136352156151866664 and EPF_BUDGET = 7 PF_BUDGET = 954465093063066648 replace the E-lane term of WB; WB = 63559663259643535433 and W_CTX = 45591924.

heuristics.statement: For a uniform context, (a) the expected number of list words the exact Y9 prefilter keeps is at most 0.11 times the expected number of list words, and (b) the expected number of listed entries is at least 0.99 times its exact value.
heuristics.scope: The kept-word and kept-lane work budgets of the counter walk; it does not affect the rate, the walk or which trials are found.
heuristics.extrapolation: Uniform projections give 1-(1-2^-6)^7 = 0.1044; measured on 200,000 contexts: kept share 0.10463 (largest of 20 batches 0.10610); the budget 1/8 is 1.195 x the share.
heuristics.limitations: A premise on a work count, like H4' and H_G_cluster; if it failed the run would halt and only the success probability would fall.
